newsitem.title: USA: China buys U.S. soybeans, soyoil in Oct 31 week.
newsitem.headline: China buys U.S. soybeans, soyoil in Oct 31 week.

text.p: U.S. exporters reported net sales of 105,200 tonnes of soybeans and 4,500 tonnes of soyoil to China in the week ending Oct 31, U.S. Agriculture Department said Thursday.
The 105,200 tonnes of soybeans included 55,200 in new sales and 50,000 in destination changes, USDA said.
USDA said soybean sales to China so far this marketing year totalled 598,000 tonnes, including 110,200 tonnes exported this week, the first shipment of the year.
Total U.S. soyoil sales to China are 371,500 tonnes this marketing year.
